notes: Ambiguities: (1) Criterion 3 forces a CRITICAL upheld ruling for a hyperparameter sweep on the authors' own small evaluation prompt set, a practice that is routine in training-free generation papers; the skill has no allowance for such self-built eval sets with no hidden-label split, so the cap of 3 comes from the protocol rule rather than from the AC test alone (the EIC text says the margin size is not a reason to downgrade). (2) related_search.py counts each hyphenated word as two concept words, so 'training-free motion control video' was refused as 5 words; this is not documented. (3) The skill orders Phase 1.5 after the reports are drafted, but the claim list for the queries comes from R1's claim map, and the review file is written once, so the order was kept only conceptually in one context. (4) Several reports rely on figures that were unavailable (Fig. 1 absent entirely). (5) scores_before.json uses the same pool positions and dimension scores as scores.json; the EIC pool position (54) is not an input to the script. (6) The harness blocked shell variables and loops, so each script call used literal paths.
